No Chrome trace or GPU query observer

visualReview.method: Viewed each of the four original candidate PNGs at native resolution, and the corresponding baseline terrain PNGs; baseline flat image also checked by receipt hash.
findings: At z12.4 route-ready, flat image is byte-identical to baseline; no RTT change applies while terrain is disabled.
At z12.4 terrain-ready, route, waypoint, labels, relief silhouette and controls remain visible. No material new missing geometry or UI occlusion was identified in this frame.
At z15.91 both variants show the same broad coarse hillshade field and visible route, water lines and waypoint near the upper-left/top; no new obvious discontinuity was identified.
At z18 both variants retain coarse broad fill, a shallow diagonal boundary and the loading-details notice. This pre-existing appearance is not proof that all map content is loaded.
limitations: These four DPR1 desktop frames do not establish hardware-GPU, mobile or all-zoom visual quality.
No pixel-identical rendering claim for terrain frames; reducing only SwiftShader RTT sampling resolution is an intentional quality/performance tradeoff.

supported: The patch activates on the observed SwiftShader context: captured drape textures and hillshade RTT viewport are 1024 by 1024 instead of 2048 by 2048.
Canvas and depth target remain 1041 by 928 at DPR1; terrain DEM texture remains 516 by 516, hillshade input 514 by 514, and drape anisotropy 16.
All recorded terrain and terrain-depth draws retain 101376 indices per draw and the same 166 plus 39 draw counts.
All 120 timer queries completed with no disjoint, unavailable, errors, interference, event drops or group drops.
The sampled hillshade and mipmap costs are lower, including the sample medians; the gain is not confined to the first expensive sample.
The candidate cold diagnostic reaches the exact upper bound 17.99999998199918.
notEstablished: The first eight calls of each program/FBO/viewport group are not a random or full-workload sample. Do not extrapolate their total to all 22 candidate or 24 baseline hillshade calls.
Lower sampled RTT cost does not establish uniform end-to-end improvement: the final partial zoom step is slower, and terrain drape samples are slower.
One cold diagnostic per source is not a statistically controlled benchmark or a full release pass. The unchanged warm full-matrix gate is still required.
Observed texture IDs and calls are not counts of resident resources; no memory-growth or resource-leak conclusion is made.
Generic Chrome WebGL trace event counts are not used as draw counts.
The configured three illumination directions do not establish three executed shader lights. Offline actual-SDK evidence records NUM_ILLUMINATION_SOURCES 1; see the separate hillshade diagnosis.
